author: kycrafft
body:
I think its possible for the server to make custom messages with certain plugins. 
It would be nice not to see so many of the messages being "slain by" or "shot by"

Examples:

Player 1 took Player 2's arrow to the knee (shot)
Player 1 got poked by Player 2's arrow (shot)
Player 1 took Player 2's arrow in the knee (shot)
Player 1 got the sharp end of player 2's sword in their face (slain)
Player 1 thought the ground was soft (fell)
Player 1 didn't know there was a hole there (void)
Player 1 was chopped into pieces by Player 2 (slain)
Player 1 is not a fish (drowned)
Player 1 cannot breathe in stone (suffocation)
Player 1 forgot to check the temperature of their bath (lava)
Player 1 thought there were parachutes in Minecraft. Sorry. (fell)
Player 1 took a leap of faith (fell)  (Mustardman)
Player 1 though fire would be more comfortable (burned) (globit)
Player 1 had a climbing accident caused by Player 2   <-- xD (ladder) (bmb)
Player 1 was spotted by a sniper named Player 2 (shot) (eagle)
Player 1 thought there was ground under the map (void) (beggstar)
Player 1 thought they could fly. Nice try. (void) (beggstar)
Player 1 forgot how to stop drop and roll (fire) (FightToFi- I mean FightToWin)
Player 1 yolo swagged off a cliff (fell) (MLGtino)
Player 1 forgot to pack lunch (Starvation) (diamondporkchop)
Player 1 learned how TNT works (diamondporkchop)
Player 1 forgot about the law of gravity (Fell) (diamondporkchop)
Player 1 tried to find Atlantis (Drowning) (diamondporkchop)
Player 1 was banished into the void by Player 2 (spleef) (Roman)
Player 1 failed to parkour(fell into the void) (Roman)
